bootstrap.title: Create the administrator account
bootstrap.intro: No administrator exists yet on this installation. The account you create here is the bootstrap administrator: it keeps root administration whatever the OIDC rules.
bootstrap.warning: This screen disappears for good as soon as the account exists, and its creation is logged.

errors.closed: An administrator already exists: this screen is closed.

weakPassword.min_length: The password needs at least {{limit}} characters.
weakPassword.max_length: The password allows at most {{limit}} characters.

invalid.email: This email address is not accepted.
invalid.username: Username: 3 to 64 characters, lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore, starting with a letter or digit.

errors.unexpected: The account could not be created. See the back-office logs.

errors.throttled: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.unexpected: Sign-in failed. See the back-office logs.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.intro: Secrets of this installation: OIDC client secrets, repository tokens, service credentials. A value is encrypted in the database and never shown again; other screens select a secret by name.

create.title: New secret
create.neverShownAgain: The value will never be displayed again, not even to you.

invalid.slug: Identifier: 2 to 63 characters, lowercase letters, digits and dashes, not starting with a dash.
invalid.label: Label: 1 to 200 characters.
invalid.secret_type: Type: 2 to 64 characters, uppercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
invalid.value: Value: required, at most 16 KiB, and never a ${…} reference.

errors.slugTaken: This identifier is already used by another secret.
errors.inUse: This secret is still used and cannot be deleted. Detach it from:
errors.unexpected: The operation failed. See the back-office logs.

picker.orphan: The selected secret ({{slug}}) no longer exists. Choose another one.

cultures.title: Cultures
cultures.intro: Every culture already exists; activate the ones this installation uses. Active cultures are offered wherever a value is entered per culture.
cultures.keepValues: Deactivating a culture deletes nothing: values entered for it are kept and come back if it is reactivated.

errors.fallback: en-US is the fallback of the installation and cannot be deactivated.
errors.unexpected: The change failed. See the back-office logs.
